messages:
Avery: Dropping a short live thread after today's all-hands. Ask anything about mission, market positioning, competitors, or roadmap clarifications. Keep it brief and we'll tag folks.

Nadia: Quick — for buyer decks, should we lead with 'predictable latency' or 'cost controls'? Sales wants a single hero message.

Sam: Hero depends on buyer. For product/engineering orgs: predictable latency + rollout controls. For procurement/finance: cost controls + committed tiers. Suggest creating two slide templates.

Lee: Competitors: any change in how we talk about cloud providers who now advertise cheaper instances?

Riya: Short rebuttal: cheaper instances don't mean predictable unit economics. Call out hidden tail latency, cold KV misses, and rollout risk. Emphasize our SLA, per-route observability, and private deployment controls.

Nadia: Mission copy concern  are we keeping "developer-first" on the website or swapping to an economics-first tagline?

Avery: We keep developer-first as the primary mission. Marketing will add an economics-focused subheading for buyer-facing pages. Core messaging stays engineer-friendly.

Sam: For SEs on calls: show model catalog + runtime optimizations in that order. Engineers like a quick win (model choice) then the hard part (latency/cost).

Lee: Roadmap ask: where are per-route dashboards and tracing? SEs need them for demos.

Riya: Per-route token/cost dashboards + tracing are prioritized; internal alpha for tracing in Q2, public beta Q3, dashboards Q3.

Nadia: Do we have a one-sentence summary to compare vs self-hosted stacks? Partners ask for a quick line.

Avery: "Self-host grade control with a hosted, SLA-backed experience 1 no heavy infra ops required." Short and communicative.

Sam: Demo workaround until tracing: use per-request logs + a synthetic replay to show fallback. Example config to demo fallback:

```json
{"route":"demo-chat","fallback":["rwd-small","rwd-tiny"],"latency_slo_ms":140}
```

Lee: Any upcoming changes to Dedicated packaging or burst options? I heard talk of burst credits.

Avery: We're rolling out a burst-credit add-on and clearer committed tiers. No headline price changes yet; Finance will publish details and an FAQ next week.

Riya: Collateral note: SEs can request the internal perf pack now; external sanitized benchmarks planned for Q2 blog. Ping me for access.

deploy-bot: all-hands-slide-deck uploaded to #docs at 1839000170 :white_check_mark:

Nadia: Thanks  this helps. If we need tailored messaging for a prospect, who should we loop in?

Sam: Loop in me and Riya; we'll craft a 1-slide objection handler and a one-pager ASAP.

Avery: Great thread  keep questions short or DM for sensitive topics. Leaving this open for 24h. :sparkles:
